audit.why: The prose addresses the owner in second person, so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy. These templates were authored for a male enemy and only the champion name was substituted, leaving the pronouns wrong. champ-data/champ-gender.js is the authority.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 heavily favor Brand: his Pillar of Flame and Conflagration are AoE tools that damage Yuumi's ADC regardless of whether Yuumi is attached, and Yuumi has no way to poke back or peel the zone. Yuumi wants to stay glued to her carry and sustain, but Brand simply pokes the carry down turn after turn. If Yuumi ever detaches to land her own Q, Brand can Ablaze-and-stun her the instant she's a real target. Ward normally, but the lane pressure is Brand's from level 1.

edits.before: From 3-6 Brand snowballs the poke advantage. His E spreads Blaze between the attached duo, and a stacked passive detonation on the ADC chunks a percentage of their health that Yuumi's heals struggle to refund. The core threat is the detach punish: Yuumi has to unattach to cast Q or ult accurately, and any such window lets Brand E-Q stun-burst her out of the game. At level 6 Pyroclasm on the glued pair plus a full combo can flat-out win the lane, since Yuumi's kit offers no burst and no escape for either of them.

edits.before: At two items Brand keeps the edge in the teamfight sense that matters to this lane: his AoE burst punishes the grouped-up comps Yuumi enables, and Yuumi's untargetability while attached does nothing to stop E-spread Blaze detonations and Pyroclasm bounces landing on her host. Yuumi scales into a strong peel-and-heal enchanter, so she's more relevant late than early, but head-to-head Brand still out-damages and out-pressures the lane. Whenever Yuumi detaches to reposition or land her ult, she remains a one-combo kill for Brand.
